# defectdojo_product_type (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo product type by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_product_type" "by_name" {
  name = "Web Applications"
}

data "defectdojo_product_type" "by_id" {
  id = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the product type to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the product type to look up, compared exactly. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `authorized_users` (Set of Number) The IDs of the users who may access the product type and its products, in addition to superusers and staff.
- `critical_product` (Boolean) Whether the products of this type are critical.
- `description` (String) The description of the product type.
- `key_product` (Boolean) Whether the products of this type are key products.
